name: SVN-Web
description: Apache Subversion (SVN) is an open-source version control system that manages files and directories, and the changes made to them, over time. This container serves SVN repositories over HTTP via Apache mod_dav_svn, providing both web browsing and WebDAV checkout access.

notes.text: Create a repository with `svnadmin create /srv/svn/<name>`, then run `chown -R www-data:www-data /srv/svn/<name>`.
Repositories are anonymously readable. Write access requires a valid user in `/etc/svn/passwd`.
